#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

long long int mod_pow(long long int base, long long int exp) {
    long long int mod = 1000000007;
    long long int result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long int p, k, power = 1;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        power = p - 1;
    } else if (k == 1) {
        power = p;
    } else {
        long long int x = k;
        while (x != 1) {
            x = (x * k) % p;
            power++;
        }
        power = (p - 1) / power;
    }
    cout << mod_pow(p, power) << endl;
    return 0;
}
